artifact_evidence.submitted_query: SELECT c.region, strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(o.total_amount - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS net_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY c.region, month
